currentSlice.detail: §12.49(4) steps 1-3 landed at 53864d10ad (tags declared, structural gate green). Step 4 — the dispatch gate — cannot land before a tag-to-class mapping exists: with no riskRules configured every action classifies by the unknown default, so wiring the gate first would put every tool call behind approval. The mapping is a product judgment and is with the delegate.
